{{Top|leg}}
'''Snoop''' was the designation for a [[T-65BR X-wing reconnaissance starfighter]] that flew with [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]. While on a reconnaissance mission to investigate a rendezvous point where the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Urias Xhaxin|Xhaxin]] was ambushed, Snoop released twin sensor pods to collect data on the area. While collecting the data, the Rogues engaged and defeated [[Yorik-et|coralskippers]] which appeared from the wrecked hulls of the pirate's [[Starship/Legends|ships]], while Snoop stayed back in safety. After the brief [[Starfighter combat/Legends|dogfight]], [[Rogue Leader/Legends|Rogue Leader]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Gavin Darklighter]] ordered Snoop to return to the ''[[Ralroost]]'' and present the collected data to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Traest Kre'fey|Kre'fey]].<ref name="DTO">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide I: Onslaught]]''</ref>
